author: nekolexio
quote: The critics' perfect scores put the game in a worser spot than it could've been and cast a perceptional bias this game reaaally didn't need given the state it released in. Congratulations to Rockstar for achieving commercial success but now that it's out of the way it's important to be honest: GTA6 is not a 100 and it's insane it was scored so highly. It's big, stylish, boasts a diverse and responsive environment, but it's by no means peak and shouldn't be left to history as such. Its expansions on the open world concept are great but not technologically groundbreaking (they're not adaptable by anyone who can't solve technical limitations with a huge budget and thus won't move the industry forward), some other gameplay elements are straight-up a downgrade and often unsatisfying, and the story and characters don't compensate for any of that. So yeah... disappointed in the game, but more so in the journalists for ballooning my expectations to where they were much harder to meet. Nothing will make GTA 6 less culturally impactful, lucrative or fun to run (especially when it's patched) if it sits at a much more modest score it deserves, and would've honestly gotten had critics been actually critical

quote: My first Zelda game as an adult who missed it in the early 2000s and it’s absolutely magical. A simple but beautiful and wholesome story, the kind of which are rare and dearly missed these days. Hyrule looks incredible. A word that stays with you and you want to stay with.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
